digest.component_or_area: DC adapter test guard for pagination
propositions: The structural guard scans only transport.py, but commit 465d moved all search_issues() calls into _base.py and _issues.py, leaving the guard with zero call sites to police.
The guard's predicate now unconditionally passes (assert not []) because its hardcoded scan path no longer contains the construct it polices.
The guard must be widened to scan every *.py in adapters/jira_datacenter/ and must assert that the widened scan observes a non-zero population of call sites.
A non-vacuity assertion is the anti-rot fix: a future module move that empties the directory must turn the test RED instead of silently disarming it.
Four additional single-file AST guards in the test suite suffered the same rot from 465d's split and are confirmed vacuous.
